name: Rover's Day Out

description: Winner of IFComp 2009: a morning routine, a dog, and a spaceship on a 1200-degree exoplanet. Text adventure in English (Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman, 2009). Non-commercial licence. Type if-rovers-day-out in the Terminal or tap the icon.
